categories.label: Cafés
categories.description: Places explicitly mapped as cafés. Bars, coffee retailers and bakeries do not count unless a café is separately identified.

categories.label: Supermarkets
categories.description: Shops explicitly mapped as supermarkets. Convenience stores, grocery stalls and specialist food shops are excluded.

categories.label: Cinemas
categories.description: Venues explicitly mapped as cinemas. Theatres, arts centres and screening equipment alone do not qualify.

categories.label: Bookshops
categories.description: Shops primarily selling books. Libraries, public bookcases and stationery shops are separate types.

categories.label: Libraries
categories.description: Facilities explicitly mapped as libraries. Bookshops, book-exchange boxes and archives alone do not qualify. Admission rules may apply.

categories.label: Pharmacies
categories.description: Facilities explicitly mapped as pharmacies. Cosmetics shops, herbalists and other health retailers are excluded.

categories.label: Restaurants
categories.description: Venues explicitly mapped as restaurants. Fast-food outlets, cafés, bars and food shops alone do not qualify.

categories.label: Parks
categories.description: Areas explicitly mapped as parks. Gardens, playgrounds, grass verges and other green land are excluded.

categories.label: Post offices
categories.description: Facilities explicitly mapped as post offices. Post boxes, parcel lockers and collection points alone do not qualify.

categories.label: Banks
categories.description: Facilities explicitly mapped as bank branches. Standalone ATMs and financial-company offices are excluded.

categories.label: Medical care
categories.description: Doctor practices, clinics and hospitals explicitly mapped as such. These are different services, not interchangeable emergency-care options; the recorded type appears with each place.

categories.label: Gyms
categories.description: Fitness centres, or sports centres explicitly offering fitness training. General sports venues and facilities dedicated to other sports are excluded.
